name: Dacity Coin (Solana original)
thesis: Oct 16: the only coin with an on-screen tie to GTA VI (Dacity Coin on a plane in the official launch trailer; in-game lore has Lucia promoting it). Oldest of 20+ copycats, launched Oct 11 before the trailer. ~$1.4M vs the Robinhood Chain copy at ~$21M. Catalyst: GTA VI launches Nov 19. Risks: already ran ~30x in an hour then halved, Rockstar could disavow it, copycats split the money.
